The DfE subject content for GCSE physics is an unnumbered bullet list, so the coverage references are this book's index of the DfE's named topic headings, in the DfE document's order. Higher tier is a superset of Foundation: the DfE marks Higher-only statements with an underline, and the boards re-express that as (HT only) (AQA) or bold type (Edexcel, OCR). Physics-only content (the separate-science award's extra topics, e.g. Space physics) is a different tag from Higher-only content and is not tagged H.
